findings.current: Leaving behind the tremendous impact and explosion that shook the cliffs lining both sides, though my attack had missed its target, I planted my foot on the ground once more.
findings.defect: The draft says Taekyung’s attack missed. The force he split is what veered off target and struck the cliffs.
findings.rationale: The preceding sentence identifies the split attack as the North Heaven Demon Lord’s Palm Force.
findings.replacement: Leaving behind the tremendous impact and explosion as the deflected Palm Force shook the cliffs on either side, I planted my foot on the ground once more.
findings.source: 목표를 벗어나 좌우에 늘어선 암벽을 뒤흔드는 엄청난 충격과 폭발음을 뒤로한 채, 다시 한번 지면을 밟았다.

findings.current: And the energy crashing down from behind him at a speed like a flash of light was just as immense as his.
findings.defect: The approaching energy is behind Taekyung, not behind the North Heaven Demon Lord.
findings.rationale: Taekyung immediately turns aside, revealing the flame that his own body had concealed.
findings.replacement: And the energy crashing down from behind me at a speed like a flash of light was just as immense as his.
findings.source: 그리고 섬광과도 같은 속도로 등 뒤에서 짓 쳐드는 누군가의 기운은, 북천마군이 지닌 그것과 비견될 만큼 거대했으니까.

findings.defect: A silent identification of the Fire King has been replaced with a sound effect.
findings.rationale: The words are formed by the Demon Lord’s barely moving lips; the following sentence explicitly calls it a soundless cry.
findings.source:
화. 왕.

자그맣게 달싹이는 입술이 소리 없는 외침을 토해 낸다.

findings.current: The world shook. A relentless wave of force swept in every direction, and the ground crumbled beneath the three of us.
findings.defect: “The three of us” includes Taekyung, who has stepped aside, rather than the three fighters locked in the clash.
findings.rationale: The North Heaven Demon Lord is holding off Jeok Cheongang and the Bow Saint while Taekyung stands apart.
findings.replacement: The world shook. A relentless wave of force swept in every direction, and the ground crumbled beneath the three combatants.
findings.source: 거칠 것 없는 힘의 파도가 사방을 휩쓸었고 세 사람의 발끝에서 지면이 붕괴했다.

findings.current:
“Murong Baek, the Divine Spear of the Two Dragons. No—the North Heaven Demon Lord. It’s time to accept the consequence of your choice.”

There’s a reason and a history behind every martial artist’s sobriquet.

So when I heard the unfamiliar one slip from the Bow Saint’s lips, I had a vague sense that I understood the life Murong Baek had lived.

Two Dragons.
findings.defect: The draft treats 이룡(螭龍) as the established collective title “Two Dragons,” changing the identity and meaning of Murong Baek’s sobriquet.
findings.rationale: The specified characters are 螭龍, not the characters for “two dragons”; the next lines explain the image as an imugi that never became a dragon.
findings.replacement:
“Murong Baek, the Divine Spear of the Imugi. No—the North Heaven Demon Lord. It’s time to accept the consequence of your choice.”

There’s a reason and a history behind every martial artist’s sobriquet.

So when I heard the unfamiliar one slip from the Bow Saint’s lips, I had a vague sense that I understood the life Murong Baek had lived.

The imugi.
findings.source:
“이룡신창(螭龍神槍) 모용백. 아니, 북천마군. 이제 네 선택의 결과를 받아들일 때다.”

무림인의 별호에는 그만한 이유와 시간이 있다.

그렇기에 궁성의 입술 사이로 흘러나온 낯선 별호를 들었을 때, 나는 모용백이 살아온 삶을 어렴풋이 알 것 같다는 생각이 들었다.

이룡(螭龍).

summary: The draft changes several combat positions and misidentifies Murong Baek’s sobriquet.
